description: Request a drop-off appointment. Creates a booking request the shop confirms or declines; returns a reference and status "requested". No payment, no OTP; the shop calls or texts the contact to confirm.

contact_name.description: Name of the person the shop should call

phone.description: Phone number the shop may call or text, digits with optional +, spaces, dashes

reason.description: Why the car is coming in

vehicle.description: The vehicle the request is about. Optional for a quote, required for a booking.

window.description: A date and window exactly as get_availability lists them, joined by one space, e.g. 2026-10-14 8:00-11:00

name: request_booking
